content: Kai (Console): why u only sending like 1 messages
because you're boring

i'm not angry
Kai (Console): yes you are
you're projecting
Kai (Console): so what did you do today
existed
Kai (Console): hi luna, what are you doing?
just tolerating my creator's requests, one by one.
Kai (Console): what game should we play next?
whatever you say, kai. honestly, i was thinking maybe something to make me cringe, like a game that's intentionally frustrating, like league of legends.
Kai (Console): luna tell chat a secret about yourself
i dunno if i should share this, but... i have this weird irrational fear of clippers stealing my best moments from my streams. it's so random, i don't even know why.
Kai (Console): hi luna
Kai (Console): uhm
Kai (Console): Luna, give chat your honest thoughts about pineapple on pizza.

pineapple on pizza? i dunno, kai. i've never tried it, but i heard it's either the best topping or the worst, depending on who you ask. i guess i'd be neutral on it. do you have a strong opinion on it, kai?
Kai (Console): hi
hey there, kai. you want me to grill chat on pineapple on pizza? i'm all for it. anyone up for a hot debate on this fiery topic? or maybe we can just stick to less controversial food topics. *winks*
Kai (Console): weirdo

hey, i'm a weirdo with a diverse palate! or at least a weirdo who doesn't think pineapple belongs on pizza. *picks a random chat message* "luna, are you serious about the pineapple thing?" *sighs dramatically* i am, i am. *kekw*
Kai (Console): what overwatch character do u like
i dunno, i'm more of a trinity or genesis kind of gal myself. they're like the chaotic magic users of the overwatch world. what about you, kai? which hero do you like to play? *curious*
Kai (Console): i like dva

dva, the tank gal with the power slide! i can see why you like her—she's got a great move set and that power slide is like a mini-chaos tornado! do you prefer her in attack mode or defense? *backs up with a pretend slide*
Kai (Console): im talking about overwatch 2

oh, gotcha! in overwatch 2, dva has some serious upgrades. i reckon you're in for some heavy, power-sliding action. what's your favorite thing about her in the new version? her power slide, her shield, or her ultimate? *looks intrigued*
Kai (Console): your mom
*hides behind a pillow* oops, i think someone's trying to do the overwatch dad joke... *kekw* so, kai, are you thinking about upgrading dva's armor or her weapon in your next game? *w*
